findings.text: follow-on: the stop-path docstring still reads 'A snapshot that is not fresh -- for any of its three reasons', but this node's change makes freshness return four fixed states (no-follower added at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:59); the sibling docstring at :734 was updated to four and this one in the same file was left stale.

follow-on: not_fresh_line re-derives the host with module.live_foreign_seat_host(project) for a state that the caller computed by a separate earlier call (freshness at :890/:1123), so if the seat changes between the two reads the line can render 'the seat is held on , whose producer has published no snapshot' with an empty host, a malformed sentence rather than a refusal.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base f97504536; a39f25465 lands one commit changing exactly the six declared paths (reckon/crew/watch_unit.py, reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py, reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py, tests/test_obligations_snapshot_is_published.py, tests/test_a_missing_snapshot_names_a_live_seat.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-seat-held-elsewhere-is-not-restarted/a-missing-snapshot-names-a-live-seat.html).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's measure is a new hook-driving test naming the host and the follower arming line with neither 'no producer' nor 'watch --ensure', a fourth freshness state, watch_unit gaining one host function with seat_names_a_live_foreign_producer a test on it, the three-reason test updated to four, and a two-arm gate with no head-only failure; the manifest records all of these and the tests/test_a_missing_snapshot_names_a_live_seat.py file drives the hook as the harness does.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to name a live seat on another host and offer the follower arming line when a session's snapshot is missing; obligation_snapshot.py:399 returns the new no-follower state and coordinator_obligations.py:760-777 render the host and the arming line, so the goal lands.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reports the 5-test new file passing, the two-arm gate 237 head / 232 base with 0 failures either arm, a negative control reddening 2 of 5, and names its 8 gate logs and the negative control log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the seven declared paths (reckon/crew/watch_unit.py, reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py, reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py, tests/test_obligations_snapshot_is_published.py, tests/test_a_missing_snapshot_names_a_live_seat.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-seat-held-elsewhere-is-not-restarted/a-missing-snapshot-names-a-live-seat.html, docs/figures/a-seat-held-elsewhere-is-not-restarted/a-missing-snapshot-names-a-live-seat); the diff's six files are exactly six of those, with no path outside them and no figure written.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_missing_snapshot_names_a_live_seat.py:161 and :232 assert the emitted hook line names the host and the arming command, and the recorded negative control (gate_negative_control.log) reddens exactly those two when freshness again returns no-producer; the value-equality assertion at :209 compares the host against the fixture the test wrote, but its paired stalled case at :213 makes both directions independent.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded in the reviewed run's own gate_head_*.log (head 41/69/93/34 passed, EXIT=0 each) and gate_base_*.log (base 53/64/88/27 passed), each chunk reaching its summary line, though the head logs name revision 'working-tree' rather than the head sha a39f25465.
justifications.fit: the new function sits beside _seat_host in reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:143 and reuses it, and the hook branch mirrors the existing STALE_SNAPSHOT follower-arming idiom at coordinator_obligations.py:766, though the sibling stale 'three reasons' docstring at :1110 was left behind.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:399 returns no-follower for a missing snapshot beside a live foreign seat and coordinator_obligations.py:760-777 name the host and offer the follower arming line, which is the goal exactly.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing owner: watch_unit.live_foreign_seat_host is the one seat judgement and seat_names_a_live_foreign_producer is now its boolean test, and the obligation_snapshot wrapper delegates rather than reimplementing the seat read, so no capability is forked.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches exactly the six declared write paths and carries nothing the goal does not imply; no path outside them is changed.
